FIDELITY LIMITATIONS (unmeasured original behaviour, none claimed by this report): (1) the byte layout, version field and id encoding of a stored plane stay UNKNOWN — no such file ships and no original run happened; affected content: every F64 legacy-import row; resolving task: an owner capture of a runtime-created Planes\ file; (2) whether a stored loadout lives inside the plane file or separately is unmeasured — affected content: the custom-loadout row; resolving task: the same capture; (3) the census classifies by what production readers parsed, never by extension, so a non-container file's interior is not claimed to be anything — affected content: the 42 plain files; resolving task: none needed, the engine templates name where the originals live and none ships. `unknowns` is empty because every measurement THIS report made resolved: every file classified, every member decoded or listed, and every candidate examined.
